varieties.name: Local dhania strain
varieties.supplier_notes: Selected for aroma; the market standard.

varieties.name: Slow-bolting line
varieties.supplier_notes: The upgrade for hot seasons — bolts later.

timeline_template.description_en: Sow shallow (1 cm) broadcast or 25 cm rows, 6-8 kg seed per acre. Basal 50 kg DAP.
timeline_template.description_sw: Panda kina cha 1 cm kwa kutapanya au mistari 25 cm, kilo 6-8 za mbegu. Weka kilo 50 za DAP.
timeline_template.tip_en: Rub or soak seed overnight to split the husk — emergence halves from 3 weeks to ~10 days.
timeline_template.tip_sw: Sugua au loweka mbegu usiku — kuota kunapungua kutoka wiki 3 hadi siku ~10.

timeline_template.description_en: First weeding — dhania seedlings hate weed shade more than any other crop.
timeline_template.description_sw: Palia kwanza — miche ya dhania haivumilii kivuli cha magugu.

timeline_template.description_en: Top-dress 50 kg CAN per acre; repeat at week 5. Leaf crops are nitrogen engines.
timeline_template.description_sw: Weka kilo 50 za CAN; rudia wiki 5. Mboga za majani zinahitaji nitrojeni.

timeline_template.description_en: Cut at 15-20 cm leaving 2-3 cm stubble — the plant re-grows for a second and third cut.
timeline_template.description_sw: Kata sentimita 15-20 ukiacha cm 2-3 — mmea unachipua tena.
timeline_template.tip_en: THE succession rule: sow a fresh strip every 2 weeks — one sowing is a flush, a strip system is a weekly harvest.
timeline_template.tip_sw: Kanuni ya mfululizo: panda sehemu mpya kila wiki 2 — kupanda mara moja ni zao moja, mfululizo ni mavuno kila wiki.

post_harvest.grading_criteria: Bunch by freshness; reject bolted or yellowed stems.
post_harvest.storage_tips_en: Cut in the cool morning and sell the same day — dhania wilts by afternoon.
post_harvest.storage_tips_sw: Kata asubuhi na uza siku hiyohiyo — dhania hunyauka mchana.

diseases.symptoms_en: Seedlings collapse at the soil line, brown pinched stems, in wet spells.
diseases.symptoms_sw: Miche huanguka kwenye uso wa udongo, mashina meusi, mvua nyingi.
diseases.treatment_en: Seed-dressing where wet; no rescue for collapsed patches. Advisory: use PCPB-registered products only, at label rates.
diseases.treatment_sw: Dawa ya mbegu sehemu zenye unyevu; hakuna uokozi wa mapande yaliyoanguka. Shauri: tumia dawa zilizoidhinishwa na PCPB tu, kwa kiwango kilichoandikwa.
diseases.prevention_en: Raised beds, thin sowing, well-drained nursery.
diseases.prevention_sw: Vitanda vilivyoinuliwa, panda kidogo, kitalu kisicho na maji.
diseases.scanner_notes: Photograph a whole patch — the pattern is the diagnosis.

diseases.symptoms_en: Colonies curl new growth; honeydew on leaves.
diseases.symptoms_sw: Makundi yanakunja majani machanga; utomvu majani.
diseases.treatment_en: Squash early colonies; registered products if spreading. Advisory: use PCPB-registered products only, at label rates.
diseases.treatment_sw: Ponda makundi ya mwanzo; nyunyuza ikiwa yanaenea. Shauri: tumia dawa zilizoidhinishwa na PCPB tu, kwa kiwango kilichoandikwa.
diseases.prevention_en: Weekly underside scouting, natural enemies first.
diseases.prevention_sw: Chunguza chini ya majani kila wiki, maadui wa asili kwanza.
diseases.scanner_notes: Underside photo with the colony visible.

diseases.symptoms_en: Brown ringed spots on leaves, yellowing, humid weather.
diseases.symptoms_sw: Madoa ya kahawia yenye pete, kuwitikia, unyevu.
diseases.treatment_en: Registered alternaria-active sprays at first spots. Advisory: use PCPB-registered products only, at label rates.
diseases.treatment_sw: Dawa za alternaria zilizoidhinishwa mara madoa yanapoanza. Shauri: tumia dawa zilizoidhinishwa na PCPB tu, kwa kiwango kilichoandikwa.
diseases.prevention_en: Clean seed, rotation, avoid leaf wetness.
diseases.prevention_sw: Mbegu safi, zungusha, epuka majani kuloweshwa.
diseases.scanner_notes: Ringed spots distinguish from mildew dusting.

diseases.symptoms_en: White dusting on leaves in warm-dry spells.
diseases.treatment_en: Sulphur-class products at first dusting. Advisory: use PCPB-registered products only, at label rates.
diseases.treatment_sw: Dawa za salfa mara inapoanza. Shauri: tumia dawa zilizoidhinishwa na PCPB tu, kwa kiwango kilichoandikwa.
diseases.scanner_notes: White powder top of leaf, warm-dry weather.

market_notes.sell_windows_en: Demand is daily and local — the steadiest price in the vegetable trade. The succession calendar matters more than any single sowing.
market_notes.sell_windows_sw: Mahitaji ni ya kila siku — bei thabiti zaidi kwenye biashara ya mboga. Mfululizo wa kupanda ni muhimu kuliko kupanda mara moja.
market_notes.price_notes_en: 50–150 KES per kg retail, bundles at 10–20 KES (November 2026). Input bill under 12,000 KES per acre.
market_notes.price_notes_sw: KES 50–150 kwa kilo rejareja, mafungu kwa 10–20 (Novemba 2026). Gharama chini ya 12,000 KES kwa eka.
